'''Treytis Prash''' was a gun-runner for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who was eventually captured by [[Thune (bounty hunter)|Thune]]. He later died when caught in a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter's]] strafing run.
